title: Market to Pipeline
summary: Turn one offer and one bounded market into a private qualified pipeline, exact permission-aware actions, seven de-identified posts, and body-free receipts using normalized Threadify and optional Treg evidence.
triggers: turn this market into a qualified pipeline
run Market to Pipeline with Threadify and Treg
find permission-aware leads and build seven posts

inputs.name: one versioned offer, one bounded market, normalized Threadify and optional Treg evidence

outputs.name: private pipeline, exact actions, seven-post campaign, action lifecycle, and body-free receipts

free_capabilities: local deterministic qualification and deduplication for at most 50 normalized signals and 10 selected prospects
separate warm permission and cold B2B compliance readiness lanes
private JSON, CSV, and HTML review artifacts
exactly seven de-identified evidence-linked campaign posts
account/evidence/compliance-bound approval, pending-attempt persistence, authoritative reconciliation, and lifecycle-aware body-free receipts
paid_capability_stubs: Treg discovery or enrichment is optional, host-supplied, price-previewed, and separately approved before a metered call
connected Threadify reads depend on current account capabilities and entitlement
provider delivery requires a separately available channel capability and exact owner approval

must_show: verified Threadify source account, sending account, and destination
warm or cold B2B lane and every passing gate
source coverage, observation times, and limitations
quoted and charged spend against the run cap
exact action text, action hash, and idempotency key
sender identity, unsubscribe path, and suppression result when applicable
the consequence of an unknown provider result and the same-attempt reconciliation path

instructions: Use owner-approved local exports or manually normalized public business evidence when Threadify or Treg is unavailable.
Mark unavailable or incomplete sources and retain the useful private pipeline and seven-post draft without weakening any gate.
Do not claim a provider read, qualification, consent, send, response, lead count, or revenue without authoritative evidence.

must_prove: provider sequence, coverage, observation times, quotes, and charges
raw and selected counts against caps
action hashes, readiness states, and blocker counts
exactly seven campaign posts and their package hash
no raw bodies or contact destinations in the public receipt
provider write state as false, null for pending or unknown, or true only after authoritative success readback
buyer-grounded post count and context hash, or explicit legacy_unlinked status
